description: Checks whether an XRP Ledger token issuer is who it claims to be: two-way domain verification (on-ledger Domain field against the domain's xrp-ledger.toml), tokens issued and outstanding, and control flags such as freeze, clawback, blackholed, and multisign. Useful before accepting or holding a token. The first call each day returns the real answer without payment. After that, about $0.01 via x402 (USDC on Base, or XRP / RLUSD on the XRP Ledger). A payment watch is paid from the first call. Bad input and ledger outages are never charged.
name: issuer_check
title: Issuer Check
